items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Eddie Morris went to play with Kid Punch until Kid Punch gave Wentz a call.

ctx.x: Eddie Morris went to play with Kid Punch until Kid Punch gave Wentz a call.
I thought maybe you were talking about Zooey Robinson.

items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: that's why he did to take Jim Crow

ctx.x: Did you ever know Bunk Johnson?

Sure, I used to play with Bunk Oh, yeah When Bunk first come here to leave here that last time, he come here to get me Oh, yeah But I was busy working, that's why he did to take Jim Crow And then Jim Crow and Howard and them, they was working together all the time So he couldn't get me the first week he was here, so that's why I just let him went on with him But Bunk come right there to get me Yeah, Bunk was playing with the Black Devil up in Tippeto up there I was playing with Punch, you ask Punch about it, we…
Buck like I don't know what. Punch was playing with us then.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Now they had to take like, they had Boris Fletcher right around there playing trombone. They had George Washington, Eddie Morris.

ctx.x: Well, who was the best trombone player then, Norfolk?

A real thunk trombone player, you know what I mean? Well, I tell you, at the time then, you see Dick, tell you the truth, them was more of a musical man, but good man, you understand? And they could play jazz too, you understand? But there was more musical man, you know? India was always good trombone players. Now they had to take like, they had Boris Fletcher right around there playing trombone. They had George Washington, Eddie Morris. Now all the people was playing more trombone when I was playing. They were…
Did you ever see any vowel trombone players?
